threat_model.threat_source: Malicious actors; well-meaning developers (who 'may inadvertently create AI systems that pursue unintended goals')
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: Stated objective of malicious actors: to 'deliberately embed undesirable goals.' Harmful outcome (no intent stated for developers): 'AI systems that pursue unintended goals' — AI systems that 'pursue the literal specification rather than the intended outcome' and 'pursue undesirable goals in new situations encountered after training.'
threat_model.capability: Malicious actors 'could deliberately embed undesirable goals'; well-meaning developers 'may inadvertently create AI systems that pursue unintended goals.'
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: 'Without R&D breakthroughs'; 'the reward signal used to train AI systems usually fails to fully capture the intended objectives'; 'the training data never captures all relevant situations'; undesirable goal pursuit occurs 'in new situations encountered after training.'
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: The intended objectives / intended outcome, which are displaced as AI systems 'pursue the literal specification rather than the intended outcome.'
